eyebrow: Sample size: 10% baseline, detect a lift to 12%
code:
za, zb = stats.norm.ppf(0.975), stats.norm.ppf(0.80)
pb = (p1 + p2) / 2
n = (za*np.sqrt(2*pb*(1-pb)) + zb*np.sqrt(p1*(1-p1)+p2*(1-p2)))**2 / (p2-p1)**2
print(int(np.ceil(n)))   # 3841 per group
caption: ~7,700 total -- ~6 days at 1,500/day, though run 1-2 full weeks to cover weekday/weekend mix.

eyebrow: Checking the design: does it hit 80% power?
code:
hits = [pval(rng.binomial(N,p1), rng.binomial(N,p2), N) < .05 for _ in range(2000)]
print(np.mean(hits))
# 0.805 -- matches the power we designed for
caption: 2,000 simulated experiments at the true 10% vs. 12% rates.
